subject: Issue when using SparkR with Spark 1.1.0

messages.author: c41a3e50d5c239de
messages.subject: Issue when using SparkR with Spark 1.1.0
parts:
I used SparkR with Spark 0.9.0. It worked fined.
Later I want to use SparkR with Spark 1.1.0. I modified pkg/src/build.sbt to change the dependency on Spark core:
  "org.apache.spark" % "spark-core_2.10" % "1.10"
and then use ./install_dev.sh to install the SparkR package to R.

messages.author: c41a3e50d5c239de
messages.subject: Re: Issue when using SparkR with Spark 1.1.0
parts:
This is caused by a bug in Makefile that modifications to build.sbt will not trigger rebuilding.

This can be fixed by change the following line in pkg/src/Makefile:
  $(SBT_TARGET_NAME): $(SCALA_FILES) $(RESOURCE_FILES)

to

  $(SBT_TARGET_NAME): build.sbt $(SCALA_FILES) $(RESOURCE_FILES)

messages.author: c41a3e50d5c239de
messages.subject: Re: Issue when using SparkR with Spark 1.1.0
parts:
This is caused by a bug in src/pkg/Makefile that modifications to build.sbt will not trigger rebuild.

This can be fixed by changing the following line in Makefile:

$(SBT_TARGET_NAME): $(SCALA_FILES) $(RESOURCE_FILES)

to
  $(SBT_TARGET_NAME): build.sbt $(SCALA_FILES) $(RESOURCE_FILES)
